pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the frozen crimson valley of Vasarez Pass... but when declassified military radar logs finally emerged, the true horror was revealed. At the exact hour of the mass animal freeze, instruments recorded a localized, high-frequency electromagnetic beam shooting straight down from the ionosphere. It wasn't a natural weather anomaly, but a concentrated pulse of directed energy that instantly flash-froze the atmosphere and polarized every biological compass within a ten-mile radius. Government physicists never discovered who or what operated the beam, or why that specific remote valley was targeted. The classified files were sealed under national security acts, leaving only the frozen silence of the pass behind.
